title: A multimodal dataset of EEG, eye-tracking, and physiological signals during smartphone interaction
description: A multimodal neurophysiological dataset comprising simultaneous electroencephalography, eye-tracking, photoplethysmography, and galvanic skin response recordings from 23 healthy adults during naturalistic smartphone interaction and standardized video viewing. The dataset employs hardware-based synchronization to enable precise temporal alignment across modalities and includes detailed event markers for experimental conditions.
methods_description: Data were acquired using a 64-channel EEG cap and head-mounted eye tracker with concurrent photoplethysmography and galvanic skin response recordings. Participants completed two conditions: a 10-minute smartphone interaction task using personal devices and a 5-minute standardized video viewing task. Hardware-based transistor-transistor logic synchronization pulses were delivered at session onset/offset and at 20-second intervals to enable cross-modal temporal alignment.
